ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image is a schematic diagram of a plant cell; one can see a thick outer cell wall, green chloroplasts, a purple cell nucleus, a relatively large central vacuole, and some fine filament-like structures inside the cell. Reasoning: The question requires completing the sentence “Part of what makes up the cytoskeleton is _____.” The cytoskeleton is composed of protein fibers, and common components include microtubules, microfilaments, and intermediate filaments. The question only requires filling in one of the components, so microtubules should be filled in.
